diagnosis: Account is in eu-central, where private networking is not yet available; queued requests in unsupported regions remain queued indefinitely rather than failing. The account does hold the private_networking entitlement, so this is a region availability issue, not an entitlement issue.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Private networking is not yet available in your account's region (eu-central) — it is currently offered in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Requests submitted from unsupported regions remain in a queued state rather than failing, which is why yours is showing as queued. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
